For our client, a global leader in roll-on/roll-off cargo handling and storage, we are looking for a motivated Pre-Delivery Inspection Operator.

As a Pre-Delivery Inspection Operator, you ensure that every vehicle leaves the premises in top condition. You carry out inspections, prepare vehicles for delivery and make sure any defects or damage are identified and reported correctly.

Preparation and inspection

 
• 
You drive the vehicles through the car wash.

 
• 
You check that all functions are working properly, including the radio and battery.

 
• 
You inspect the tires.

 
• 
You carry out a thorough inspection to identify any damage.

 
• 
You mark any detected damage for the repair department.

Finishing and preparing for delivery

 
• 
You check and confirm the license plates.

 
• 
You equip the vehicles with a fire extinguisher, warning triangle and manuals.

 
• 
You vacuum and clean the vehicle interiors.

Other tasks

 
• 
You move vehicles to the correct zones on the premises.

 
• 
You report defects or deviations to the responsible person in a timely manner.

 
• 
You upload software updates.

What we expect from you

 
• 
You speak Dutch and/or English well enough to communicate fluently with your colleagues.

 
• 
You have a valid driving license and can drive both manual and automatic vehicles.

 
• 
You have the technical insight needed to identify and assess damage.

At 
World of Tents in Ronse, we design, develop and supply shelter solutions and crisis response equipment for organisations operating in some of the world's most demanding environments.
 

Our brands 
ALPINTER and SHIELD, support humanitarian organisations, governments, defence and emergency response teams with reliable products designed to perform when it matters most. To strengthen our Quality team, we are looking for a QHSE Specialist who combines an eye for detail with a hands-on mindset and a passion for continuous improvement in product and performance.
 

WHAT WILL YOU DO? 
As our Quality Management Officer, you contribute to the appropriate quality and reliability of our products, from raw materials to finished solutions. Working closely with our QHSE Manager, WOT Teams, international suppliers and external specialist stakeholders, you combine 
quality management processes, QA/QC coordination with our manufacturing partners and product testing, in a practical & problem-solving manner.
 

Here's where you will make a difference:
 

1. Quality Management & compliance
 
 

• Maintain and improve our Quality Management Systems (QMS), supporting ISO 9001 & 14001 compliance, internal & external audits and QA/QC procedures. 

• Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, product quality and sustainability. 

• Support Product Development and Supply Chain colleagues in Quality related aspects of their work  

2. Product Quality & Testing
 
 

• Define quality requirements and testing procedures for raw materials and finished products,  

• Coordinate product testing for core items such as tents, core relief items and other shelter-related equipment, together with internal teams and external laboratories. 

• Analyse test results, identify risks and translate findings into practical improvements.  

3. Customer & Supplier Quality
 
 

• Ensure our products meet customer specifications and quality expectations. 

• Investigate quality complaints, identify root causes and coordinate corrective actions with the teams involved. 

• Monitor incoming goods and supplier quality, following up on inspection reports and quality issues.  

4. Processes & Sustainability
 
 

• Develop, review and audit standard operating procedures and production controls. 

• Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, consistency and sustainability in collaboration with the QHSE Manager.  

You work closely with our Quality Officer, who provides practical support during product inspections and testing, and report directly to the QHSE Manager.
 

READY TO MAKE YOUR QUALITIES COUNT?
 

We'd love to hear from you! Send your CV to jobs@wot.group.

WHAT QUALITIES ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
 

We are looking for someone who combines 
technical knowledge with a practical, solution-oriented approach.
 
 

• A degree in Textile Technology, Quality Management, Engineering or a related technical field, or min 3 years of equivalent experience. 

• Experience in respect to quality control processes; experience with ISO 9001/14001 or Quality Management Systems is a plus. 

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to turn findings into clear reports and improvements. 

• Comfortable working with MS Office and Data Management systems 

• Fluent in English; Dutch and/or French are an advantage. 

• Experience with textiles, technical fabrics and/or product testing is a plus.  

And just as importantly, you:
 
 

• Are analytical, accurate and looking for solutions 

• Enjoy hands-on work and practical result driven approach 

• Take ownership and work independently. 

• Communicate easily and enjoy collaborating with different teams. 

• Are curious, proactive and eager to learn.

For a client in the metal industry, we are looking for an operator.

You will be responsible for operating the profiling line, ensuring the smooth handling of both the input and output of the machines. You will work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.

Your responsibilities:

• You will create registrations in MII/SAP. You retrieve production orders and transmit the required quantities and lengths to the machine. You perform the prescribed measurements, compare them with the specified tolerances, and adjust the process where necessary.

• You are responsible for packaging the finished product according to the given instructions.

• You handle the transport of finished goods using an overhead crane or forklift, including the required scanning and administrative registrations.

• You have completed a technical education and are able to operate a forklift confidently.

• A valid forklift certificate is considered a strong advantage.

• You have solid technical knowledge and/or a technical background.

• Experience with an overhead crane is a strong asset.

• You prioritize safety and quality at all times.

• You are able to work independently with a high level of reliability.

• You communicate fluently in English.

Are you passionate about metal, steel, engineering, welding, overhead cranes, or forklifts?

We are currently looking for several profiles to work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift in Zwevezele.

We are recruiting for the following positions:

• Press brake operators

• Forklift drivers

• Loaders and unloaders

• Overhead crane operators

• Saw machine operators

• General metalworking machine operators

Your profile

• You bring a healthy dose of enthusiasm and motivation.

• You have experience working with machines and a strong interest in technology, or experience operating a forklift.

• You have solid technical insight.

• You have a very good knowledge of Dutch and/or English.

• You are available to work Monday to Friday in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.

Working hours:

• Morning shift: starts at 5:00 or 6:00 AM, depending on the department.

• Afternoon shift: starts at 1:00 or 2:00 PM.

• Night shift: starts on Monday evening at 9:00 or 10:00 PM. On Fridays, the schedule is adjusted so you start and finish earlier, allowing you to begin the weekend sooner.

#Talent 

 

Launch Your Career with AB InBev: Graduate Management Trainee Program 

 

What is it? 

 

Our Graduate Management Trainee (GMT) programme is a  

• 10 months program starting in August 2027 
• 3-4-month rotations within the program 
• As a junior talent, you will work on real business projects situated in Sales, Commercial, Supply & Logistics 
• You will have a 70-20-10 learning and development approach, where 70% Learning on the Job, 20% Exposure to Other, 10% Formal Learning & Training 
Who are we looking for? 

 

You are willing to become a future leader within AB InBev, and should be comfortable with an ambiguous career track, and expect geographic mobility. The following qualities describe you: Leader. Proud Owner. Agile Learner. Collaborator. Future Maker. 

 To be eligible: 

• You must have graduated (before September 2027 and no more than two years prior) with a Bachelor's, Master's (or equivalent) degree. 
• You should also have no more than 2 years of professional experience (internships/volunteers/student jobs not included). 
• Your passion and ownership are more important than the subject you studied. 
• Fluent English is needed, as well as the native language of the country you are applying in. 
• A valid permanent visa/work permit is required in the country of application to be eligible for the programme.

• There is no need to upload a cover letter - this will not affect your application.

• Our Graduate Management Trainee Programme is the first step to an amazing career at AB InBev. 
• Post-Programme, you will pursue a rewarding career, often within our core functions at the heart of our business within Sales, Commercial, Supply & Logistics. 
• GMT programme will give you valuable exposure and insights into leading and transforming a successful global business. You will work on real projects with senior stakeholders to drive value and undertake a structured program to support your development as a future leader. 
 

What do we offer? 

 

Next to a competitive base salary, we put our people first by providing additional benefits: 

• Learning & Development opportunities

• Legal holidays + Compensation & additional days (40 Days in total for fulltime employment) 
• A unique Parental leave 
• Multiple Physical & Mental Wellbeing support Initiatives 
• Meal vouchers, allowances, gift per company policy 
• Competitive Life insurance, disability & medical plan 
• A Flexible Rewards system - (smartphone, bike lease, Extra pension Plan, etc.) 
 

Where?

Lead the implementation of software solutions at external clients, across functional scoping, run and upgrade projects.

Project Manager IT | B2B Software Integration | Brussels

Our client is a Belgian company specialised in integrating and implementing software solutions at its clients’ sites, recognised for its strong presence among demanding organisations.

What makes it stand out? A portfolio of strategic accounts backed by a framework contract recently renewed for six years, giving it rare visibility over its projects and its teams.

Its activity combines run, ticketing and upgrade projects on heavily customised application platforms, deployed and maintained at the client’s site.

As it grows, the company is strengthening its delivery management team and is looking for a senior Project Manager IT with a background in software integration.

The job

• Reporting to the practice lead, you take operational ownership of several client accounts and the implementation projects attached to them.
• You manage the relationship between the client, the internal teams and an external technical partner, while keeping a firm grip on the functional content of the projects.Role
• Manage the budgets, deadlines and contractual commitments of your accounts.

• Steer the external partner delivering the technical teams, and coordinate exchanges between client, partner and internal teams.
• Follow up on run and ticketing, and lead upgrade and evolution projects.
• Identify contractual, budgetary and operational risks, and bring the trade-offs to the client.
Profile
• Senior experience on the vendor side — with an integrator, a software vendor or a consultancy — implementing software solutions at external clients.
• Comfortable with the functional side of projects: you understand the solutions you deploy and can challenge an analysis or a specification rather than only coordinate. A background in functional analysis is an asset.
• Fluent English is essential; administrative rigour, diplomacy and political judgement when dealing with demanding clients.
